data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2021 the Syndicate's gross claims outstanding were GBP 794.858m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle shows an adverse movement on the 2019 underwriting year of approximately GBP 14.944m (gross), representing a modest strengthening of reserves (c.1.9% of opening reserves). The 2021 year was influenced by specific large losses including Hurricane Ida and civil unrest in South Africa, while a material reinsurance-to-close of 2018 and prior years (transferred to an external party) materially reduced older liabilities. No explicit single-sentence gross prior-year movement disclosure was found; the prior-year movement above is calculated from the gross claims development triangle.
raw_causal_phrases: improvement in underwriting performance and the RITC of 2018 and prior years of account.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (liabilities, 'Claims outstanding' 2020 comparative). No explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' sentence was located; prior year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (2019 movement = +14,944 GBP 000). The claims provisions reconciliation contains a large RITC of 2018 and prior (511,516 GBP 000 gross) which materially affected liabilities; RITC was accounted for separately and is not the basis for the prior-year development figure above. No granular per-line-of-business reserve movement figures were available, so lob_movements are not provided.
